description: Header file declaring the internal String utility class for Google Test, including static methods for string manipulation, comparison, conversion, and formatting.

classes.name: String
classes.description: A utility class providing static string manipulation methods used internally by Google Test.

methods.name: CloneCString
methods.description: Clones a null-terminated C string, allocating memory with new.

methods.name: AnsiToUtf16
methods.description: Converts an ANSI string to a UTF-16 wide string on Windows Mobile.

methods.name: Utf16ToAnsi
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 wide string to an ANSI string on Windows Mobile.

methods.name: CStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two C strings for content equality, handling NULLs.

methods.name: ShowWideCString
methods.description: Converts a wide C string to a UTF-8 encoded std::string.

methods.name: WideCStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two wide C strings for content equality, handling NULLs.

methods.name: CaseInsensitiveCStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two C strings ignoring case, handling NULLs.

methods.name: CaseInsensitiveWideCStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two wide C strings ignoring case, handling NULLs.

methods.name: EndsWithCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix, ignoring case.

methods.name: FormatIntWidth2
methods.description: Formats an integer as a two-digit string.

methods.name: FormatHexInt
methods.description: Formats an integer as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: FormatByte
methods.description: Formats a byte as a two-digit hexadecimal string.
